pluginstrument.author: CAP V-SAR
pluginstrument.description: Technisonic TDFM-136B VHF-FM mission radio as fitted to CAP aircraft, for the Mission Observer station. Two-line Main/Guard display, 230 main memories, MN/GD and G1/G2 selection, HI/LO power and the twelve-key command keypad. Routes to the CAP mission net rather than to ATC (Implementation Plan v0.8 section 6.7.3 option B).
